title: Sehmoune N Probable NDE 6966
content: Before this happened I was so intelligent. I was only 13, nevertheless I had the culture of an adult. One day I started to have backaches, I was told that it was a scoliosis. I started to wear a corset. About nine months later, there came the need to operate on me. One month after the operation, I started to feel bad. I couldn't sleep nor eat anymore. The nurse examined me and said, ‘You have to be operated on, as the staphylococcus aureus [Editor’s note: An infection.] has increased. You could die if we do not react’. So the following day I was operated to clear the problem. Just after the operation, I saw my open back. I had lost three liters of blood. At that moment I was dead, I saw a white path with my cousin and a light at the end. I talked to him. Another path was black with much blood and screaming. I saw an old woman there that I knew. Before seeing all this a spirit asked me ‘do you believe in God?’ and I said ‘yes’. Then at the end, my cousin told me to go back to my mother to take care of her. I came back to life but fell into a coma for one month and a semi-coma for two more months. When I woke up after the comas, I wasn't the same person. I had forgotten everything and couldn't control myself anymore. On the 2nd of January of this year, I woke up and was cured. I don't remember what happened during my three years’ stay at the hospital, but I was told that I did horrible things and that all my relatives suffered because of this. Now I'm cured but I don't have the same school levels as I had before.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related. Heart attack. While under general anesthesia. CPR given. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) My back was opened and at that moment I lost my life. I saw a white space with my deceased cousin and a light at the back.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I heard and saw the nurses, the nurse's aides and my family. I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Less consciousness and alertness than normal I had the impression that I felt well, being free, and being happy when I was dead.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual I felt that time was more peaceful than usual.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I had better vision; besides, since my recovery, I see very well from afar.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: He looked better, but he wasn't changed in any other way.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.The experience included: Tunnel | Presence of deceased persons | A landscape or city | Special knowledge or purpose
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was white with a brilliant light at the background; I also saw my cousin.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I had seen my cousin, who was in paradise. I think, but am not very sure, the older woman that I knew, told me something.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was not yellow as usual, but a yellow that one could not imagine and there was also some red.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was white with a supernatural garden and a big light.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: During the comas, I was weak and couldn't move nor speak.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I knew that God and His angels were with me.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will My cousin told me ‘go back to your mother’; then I came back to life.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will My cousin told me ‘go back to your mother’; then I came back to life. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Muslim A ce moment là j'étais musulmane et très croyante ainsi que pratiquante.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Uncertain It didn't change, but it increased.
elements.What is your religion now?: Muslim Je suis encore musulmane et je suis plus croyante car vu mon experyence je crois de plus en plus à cette religion.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience J'avais vu mon cousin à la base on peut pas voir les morts avant le jugement dernier et je ne savais pas qu'il y avait un jardin avec au fond une lumière. Mais par rapport à la religion je savais qu'un esprit apparaissait.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes My belief is much stronger.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin I only saw a blurred face that told me: ‘so do you believe in God? And unto whom do you also believe?’ He brought me to my cousin and let me stay there.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes J'avais vu une sorte d'esprit surement un ange vu son éblouissement je n'arrive pas à dire les mots mais il brillait.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes That after death, one will inevitably become alive again.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes Le but est de faire moins de péchets et plus d'actes positifs pour aller dans le jardin que j'avais vu.
elements.Do you believe in an afterlife after you: An afterlife definitely exists Yes Oui car l'esprit m'avais demandé si j'étais croyante et c'est là que je vu que mon cosin était finalement vivant après sa mort.
elements.Were you fearful living your life prior: Not fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Greatly fearful in living my earthly life
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes Si on a des difficultés c'est normal on nous teste.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Large changes in my life Large changes in my life. Since I became myself again, I see from afar, I hear from afar, I feel from afar and I have a more powerful touch. Sometimes I see spirits or hear voices. Often, I have premonitory dreams.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes Yes Some friends are no longer friends as they think I'm crazy; but the real ones have stayed.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Yes Some friends are no longer friends as they think I'm crazy; but the real ones have stayed. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It was so unbelievable; however I saw paradise, hell and my cousin who died years ago.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes My vision, my smelling, my hearing, my touch are much more powerful. I see spirits or hear them, and have many premonitory dreams.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I don't know, maybe I experienced this event to get a stronger belief or to take care of my mother?
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes The 2nd of January, I had started to tell about it. Certain people believed me; others thought I was crazy or lying.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Because I’ve got proof and my mother remembers what I told her.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I feel better, and have the impression that when relating this experience I'm giving a message.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: The spirit asked me if I was a believer. Then I saw that my cousin was definitely alive after his death. I saw a kind of spirit, for sure an angel. I saw his brilliance; I cannot find the right words: but he was shining. If we have difficulties in life, this is normal: we are being tested. I saw my cousin at the base; one cannot see the dead before the final judgment. I didn't know that there was a garden with a light in the background. I knew that a spirit was appearing.
